title: Product Security- Embedded / IoT
description:
**Position**
Product Security- Embedded / IoT
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description: Product Security Engineer, Embedded / IoT**
**Experience:**
2 to 10 years
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for product security professionals with hands-on experience in assessing and securing embedded systems and IoT products.
  
  
The role involves performing product security assessments, conducting VAPT, developing threat models and security requirements, reviewing security controls, and supporting SSDLC activities. The selected candidate will work closely with hardware, firmware, software, and product engineering teams to identify vulnerabilities, recommend practical mitigations, and validate remediation.
  
  
**Key Skills**

* Understanding of embedded product architecture, microcontrollers, processors, bootloaders, memory, storage, and embedded Linux and/or RTOS environments. Ability to interpret hardware block diagrams, relevant schematic sections, and firmware architecture.
* Hands-on experience assessing debug, programming, or communication interfaces such as UART, JTAG/SWD, SPI, I²C, and USB. Familiarity with device debugging, flash access, firmware acquisition, and evaluation of debug and readout protections.
* Experience with firmware extraction or acquisition, unpacking, filesystem analysis, configuration review, and static and/or dynamic analysis. Ability to identify hardcoded credentials, exposed secrets, insecure services, weak permissions, vulnerable components, and weaknesses in firmware update mechanisms.
* Experience conducting manual and tool-assisted security testing of physical devices, firmware, and exposed interfaces. Ability to validate vulnerabilities, distinguish false positives, demonstrate impact safely, and recommend relevant remediation.
* Working knowledge of threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, security risk assessment, product security requirements, secure design review, and security validation. Understanding of assets, data flows, trust boundaries, attack scenarios, and requirement-to-test traceability.
* Understanding of secure boot, firmware signing, secure OTA updates, rollback protection, authentication, authorization, cryptographic key storage, certificate management, secure communications, and production security configuration.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP and relevant embedded or IoT interfaces and protocols, such as Ethernet, Wi-Fi, BLE, CAN, MQTT, HTTP(S), and TLS. Experience capturing and analyzing traffic and assessing communication security.
* Ability to understand C/C++ code and develop or modify Python or shell scripts.
* Experience with relevant tools such as Ghidra or IDA, Binwalk, GDB, OpenOCD, Wireshark, Nmap, flash programmers, debug probes, and logic analyzers.
* Familiarity with SAST, SCA, and Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) analysis.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Review product architecture, hardware and firmware designs, interfaces, deployment environments, and use cases to identify assets, attack surfaces, trust boundaries, and security risks.
* Plan and execute hardware and firmware VAPT using black-box, grey-box, or white-box approaches, as applicable. Assess physical access, debug interfaces, firmware, operating-system configuration, services, communication interfaces, and device management interfaces.
* Perform firmware analysis, binary analysis, reverse engineering, and security-focused source code reviews where applicable. Investigate vulnerabilities and document reproducible evidence, root causes, and product impact.
* Develop and maintain threat models, security risk assessments, product security requirements, security test plans, test cases, and traceability records throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate security controls, including secure boot, signed firmware updates, rollback protection, credential handling, access control, secure communications, and debug restrictions.
* Execute or review SAST, SCA, and firmware/binary scanning results. Analyze SBOMs, assess vulnerability applicability, eliminate false positives, and prioritize findings based on exploitability, exposure, and product impact.
* Prepare technical reports with findings, evidence, risk ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineering teams, verify fixes, and document residual risks.
* Develop reusable testing scripts, procedures, and checklists. Support security activities within development and release workflows and assess newly disclosed vulnerabilities affecting supported products.

**Location:**
IN-GJ-Ahmedabad, India-Ognaj (eInfochips)
  
  
**Time Type**
Full time
  
  
**Job Category**
Engineering Services

title: Data Loss Prevention Lead
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 The GRC Specialist is responsible for supporting the organization's security governance, conducting risk analysis, ensuring compliance with global regulations, and assisting in security audits. This role works closely with various teams to integrate risk management practices into daily operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:**
* Manage a comprehensive DLP program, including data discovery, classification, and protection policies.
* Conduct DLP and DSPM assessments to identify, mitigate, and report data protection risks.
* Ensure compliance with data protection regulations across multiple geographies.
* Collaborate with legal teams to review contracts and MSAs for DLP compliance.
* Oversee deployment and tuning of disk encryption technologies (e.g., BitLocker).
* Understanding of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and evaluate vendor risks from a DLP perspective.
* Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews to ensure DLP/DAM/DSPM considerations are integrated.
* Manage and respond to data breaches and DLP incidents.
* Stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.


**People Management**
* Foster an environment of learning, excellence, and innovation within the team and across teams.
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members.
* Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Ensure continuous professional development of team members.


**Qualifications**
**Educational qualifications \& Experience:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
* 10–12 years of experience in data loss prevention, data discovery/classification, and database/data security.
* Experience with DSPM tools and integration in hybrid environments.
* Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
* Experience with DLP, DSPM, disk encryption tools and automation.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or OSCP are a plus.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.
